mode.title: Mode
mode.description: snapshots = list archived captures of a URL (CDX); closest = find the capture nearest to given dates (CDX closest search).

urls.title: URLs
urls.description: Pages or domains, e.g. example.com or https://news.ycombinator.com/.

dates.title: Dates (mode: closest)
dates.description: Dates like 2020-06-01. One lookup per URL and date. Leave empty for the most recent capture.

fromDate.title: From date (mode: snapshots)
fromDate.description: Only captures on/after this date, e.g. 2018-01-01.

matchType.title: Match type
matchType.description: exact = this URL only; prefix = everything under the path; host = whole host; domain = host and subdomains.

collapse.title: Collapse duplicates
collapse.description: Reduce output: one capture per day / month / year, or only when content changed (unique digest).

statusCodes.title: HTTP status filter
statusCodes.description: Only captures with these HTTP status codes, e.g. 200.

maxSnapshotsPerUrl.title: Max snapshots per URL
maxSnapshotsPerUrl.description: Upper bound on rows per URL.

newestFirst.title: Newest first
newestFirst.description: Return the most recent captures first instead of the oldest.
